From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:30:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Finlytics integration - next steps and 5xx follow-up

Thanks for the repro, Samir - I had a quick look through the attached logs. Early notes:

- I correlated the customer request id rwd-req-20260227-7f4b9a to an internal gateway trace; gateway returned 502 after a 25s wait on an upstream shard. There are a handful of similar traces with 20-28s upstream waits.
- This looks like a combination of request queuing on the shard (large batches) and a few transient GPU schedule delays. Not a full OOM but request latency bumped under load.

Immediate suggestions for customer (small changes you can make now):
1) Lower batch_size to 32 (or 16) for the embedding batch call.
2) Set client timeout to 30s (your current default is 10s). If you're using the Python SDK, set timeout=30 in Embeddings.batch call or configure Session timeout.
3) Add retry with jitter and exponential backoff up to 2 retries.

For us (internal):
- Dylan, can you check autoscale/queue metrics for the us-west shard at 10:20-10:40 PST? I want to rule out a scheduler bug.
- I'll instrument an endpoint-level metric for batch_size to detect larger-than-recommended batches.

Samir - can you paste the minimal SDK snippet you're calling and your current timeout config? Also, if possible, can you run the repro with curl (I added an example below) so we have a raw HTTP trace?

Example curl for a single request (replace KEY):
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.test/v1/embeddings" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d @request-payload.json --max-time 30

Thanks - Neha
Senior Backend Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Neha - thanks, pasted the SDK snippet and timeout section below. I also ran the curl you suggested and attached the raw response headers/logs.

Python snippet (redwood==0.9.1):
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
# current call
embs = client.embeddings.batch(
  model="embed-re-rank-v1",
  inputs=request_items,  # ~60 items in failing run
  timeout=10,
  batch_size=60
)

I retried with timeout=30 and batch_size=32 and saw no failures in a quick smoke run - looks promising.

Attached: raw-curl-response.txt (includes headers with request id rwd-req-20260227-8c1d2f), updated request-payload.json (trimmed).

Samir

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finlytics integration - next steps and 5xx follow-up

Samir - great, thanks for the snippet and curl traces. Follow-up from our side:

- Root cause: high batch sizes cause requests to queue on the embedding shard under peak concurrency; queueing plus occasional GPU schedule delays produced upstream timeouts and surfaced as 502/504. No model OOMs or kernel errors in the traces you sent.
- Short-term mitigation: keep batch_size <= 32 and client timeout >= 30s. We recommend these settings for now while we roll out a scheduler improvement.
- Fix plan: we'll ship a scheduler tweak to prioritize small batches and add a backpressure signal to the gateway by 2026-03-04; that should reduce these 5xx incidents under load. I'll update this thread when the rollout is live.

Samir - once you validate stability with the new timeout/batch settings in your staging load test, let us know and we'll schedule a short follow-up to validate production readiness.

Thanks,
Neha
